build_samaudiojudge_model: build a SAMAudioJudgeModel from a SAMAudioJudgeConfig to evaluate audio generation quality
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the SAMAudioJudgeModel with text tokens and audio waveforms to get scores
create_judge_output: create a SAMAudioJudgeOutput dataclass to hold overall, recall, precision, and faithfulness score tensors
review_get_text_output: review the _get_text_output method to extract text embeddings from a configurable transformer layer
test_audio_judge_scoring: test the SAMAudioJudgeModel forward method to produce normalized overall, recall, precision, and faithfulness scores
